title: Characters (v0)
description: Tour characters. Shipped as characters.json at the bundle root. The app's v0 launch does NOT consume character data (per ADR 0006); the Cast filter is flat over Cast-classified images. We publish characters anyway so the app can pick them up post-launch without a schema bump. Tracker maintains them as the source of truth for who-appears-where, sync'd from the FDX.

character_id.description: Stable from tracker's characters.id. Used as the suffix for locale keys 'character.<id>.bio'.

name.description: Canonical ALL-CAPS name with diacritics (e.g. 'ANTONI GAUDÍ', 'FATHER PARÉS'). Matches the FDX character cue.

portrait_filename.description: Filename in /images/ (e.g. 'character-12.jpg') for this character's portrait. Null if none assigned.

scene_ids.description: Scene IDs where this character appears, derived from FDX cues.
